sources.title: Gemma4 31B QAT Uncensored HauhauCS Balanced MTP — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A community fine-tune of Google's Gemma 4 31B that removes default safety restrictions and applies quantization-aware training for efficient deployment. The 'Balanced' tag suggests HauhauCS tuned it to avoid overcorrection in either refusal rate or output quality. Accepts both text and image inputs, distributed in GGUF format for local inference.
